privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: What SetSetal knows about you, what it doesn't, and what you can do about it.
privacy.residents.title: If you're looking for a collector
privacy.residents.body: You don't sign in. SetSetal doesn't ask for your name, phone number or address, and it doesn't use your phone's location. You choose your area from a list.
privacy.residents.reports: If you send feedback, we keep what you wrote, the kind of feedback and the listing it's about, if you chose one. We don't know who sent it, so please don't put your address or phone number in it.
privacy.residents.counts: To learn where collectors are missing, we count searches that find nothing, taps on Call or WhatsApp for each listing, and feedback by type. A count never says who you are or which phone you used. There are no cookies and no advertising, and if your browser asks not to be tracked, nothing is counted.
privacy.collectors.title: If you're a collector
privacy.collectors.body: We keep the phone number you sign in with, and what you put in your listing: your name or business name, vehicle, areas, waste types, description, and your phone and WhatsApp numbers. The SetSetal team sees all of it to review your listing, and keeps a record of each decision and its reason, which you can see.
privacy.collectors.consent: Residents see your phone and WhatsApp numbers only if you tick the box that allows it, and only once your listing is approved. You can untick it at any time and the numbers disappear straight away.
privacy.collectors.delete: You can delete your listing and account from the Join screen. Your listing, numbers and sign-in are removed straight away.
privacy.phone.title: On your phone, and outside SetSetal
privacy.phone.body: So the app works without a connection, your phone keeps a copy of the listings for up to 7 days and any feedback waiting to be sent for up to 30 days. Calls and WhatsApp messages happen outside SetSetal: the collector sees the number you call or message from, and WhatsApp has its own privacy rules.
privacy.keep.title: How long we keep things
privacy.keep.body: Feedback is deleted 12 months after it's dealt with. Counts are deleted after 12 months. A listing and its decision record are kept while the listing exists; once it's deleted, the record goes within 12 months.
privacy.who.title: Who looks after this
privacy.who.body: SetSetal is a pilot run by the SetSetal team in The Gambia. The information is stored for us by Supabase (the database, in the European Union) and Netlify (the website), and sign-in codes are sent by a text-message service. Like most services, these keep short technical logs, including internet addresses, to keep things running and safe. We never sell information or use it for advertising.
privacy.who.contact: To ask what we hold about you or to have it corrected, use the feedback form on the Help screen and tell us how to reach you.
